title: 生物安全实验室：工程设施

points.K2: 设备层管着全楼通风空调
points.K3: 控制柜由电脑统一控制
points.K7: 压缩机稳住水压和气压
points.K8: 每个房间有自己的过滤器

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼前，抬手指向楼顶的排风机
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a laboratory building and points up at the exhaust fans on the roof.
shots.narration: 今天带大家看看实验室的幕后设备。
overlay: 生物安全实验室的“幕后”设备

shots.scene: 阿杰在生物安全实验室门口，看着门边空白的压差表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at the door of a biosafety laboratory looking at a blank pressure gauge beside the door.
shots.narration: 阿杰头一回进生物安全实验室。

shots.scene: 阿杰抬头看天花板上的风口，一脸疑惑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks up at the air vents in the ceiling, puzzled.
shots.narration: 他好奇：这些风从哪来，又去哪了？

shots.scene: 老李拿着手电，招手让阿杰跟他上楼
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holding a flashlight waves the young male student to follow him up the stairs.
shots.narration: 老李说：走，带你去设备层看看。

shots.scene: 实验室剖面图：下层是实验室，上层是设备层，屋顶有风机
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a building: laboratories on the lower floor, a plant room above, and fans on the roof. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全靠的不只是柜子和防护服。

shots.scene: 建筑轮廓图标和齿轮仪表图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A building outline icon next to a gear and gauge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 房子怎么设计，配什么设备，

shots.scene: 两个图标合成一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The building icon and the gear icon merge into a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 都是工程控制，从源头挡住风险。

shots.section_title: 设备层管着全楼通风空调
shots.scene: 老李和阿杰走进宽敞的设备层，四周是风管和机组
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the young male student walk into a large plant room full of air ducts and blue air handling units.
shots.narration: 这一层叫设备层，也叫机械层。
overlay: 设备层管着全楼通风空调

shots.section_title: 设备层管着全楼通风空调
shots.scene: 火焰、风扇、雪花三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a flame, a fan and a snowflake. No people.
shots.narration: 全楼的供暖、通风和空调，

shots.section_title: 设备层管着全楼通风空调
shots.scene: 从设备层伸出的风管通向楼下各个房间
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of air ducts running from the plant room down into many rooms below. No people.
shots.narration: 都从这里统一控制。

shots.section_title: 控制柜由电脑统一控制
shots.scene: 一排灰白色控制柜，指示灯亮着，柜面空白
shots.prompt_en: A long row of grey control cabinets with small glowing indicator lights and blank panels. No people.
shots.narration: 这排控制柜，管着所有电机和压缩机。
overlay: 控制柜由电脑统一控制

shots.section_title: 控制柜由电脑统一控制
shots.scene: 楼下控制室里，老李看着空白电脑屏幕
shots.prompt_en: In a control room downstairs, the facility engineer watches a computer screen showing only simple blank icons.
shots.narration: 它由楼下的电脑统一指挥。

shots.section_title: 控制柜由电脑统一控制
shots.scene: 电脑与控制柜之间一条连线，两端各有一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: A line connecting a computer icon and a control cabinet icon, with a check mark at each end. No people.
shots.narration: 哪台设备在转，一看就知道。

shots.scene: 一台蓝色的空气处理机组，箱体上没有文字
shots.prompt_en: A large blue air handling unit with a plain blank casing. No people.
shots.narration: 这台蓝色大箱子，是空气处理机组。

shots.scene: 剖面图：室外空气进入机组，穿过一层褶皱滤网
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram: outside air flows into the unit and passes through a pleated filter panel. No people.
shots.narration: 里面装着高效过滤器。

shots.scene: 滤网把小点点挡在外面，干净气流进入房间
shots.prompt_en: A pleated filter traps small dots while clean air arrows flow into a room. No people.
shots.narration: 进楼的空气，都先过这一道。

shots.scene: 老李打开机组的检修门，露出里面的滤网
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens an access door on the air handling unit, revealing the filter panels inside.
shots.narration: 过滤段有检修门，可以打开。

shots.scene: 日历图标和扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon next to a wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 定期检查、维护，

shots.scene: 旧滤网取出、新滤网装入的箭头示意
shots.prompt_en: Arrows showing an old dirty filter coming out and a new clean filter going in. No people.
shots.narration: 到期就更换过滤模块。

shots.scene: 建筑示意图：进风口和出风口各有一个滤网图标
shots.prompt_en: A building diagram with a filter icon at the air inlet and another filter icon at the air outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 进入设施的空气要高效过滤，

shots.scene: 出风口箭头穿过滤网后变干净
shots.prompt_en: An exhaust air arrow passes through a filter and comes out clean on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 排出设施的空气，也要高效过滤。

shots.scene: 阿杰点头，指着示意图的两个滤网
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods and points at the two filter icons on a blank diagram board.
shots.narration: 两头把关，里外都放心。

shots.section_title: 压缩机稳住水压和气压
shots.scene: 两台带储气罐的压缩机，机身空白
shots.prompt_en: Two air compressors with large storage tanks, plain blank casings. No people.
shots.narration: 这边是压缩机。
overlay: 压缩机稳住水压和气压

shots.section_title: 压缩机稳住水压和气压
shots.scene: 水滴图标和气流图标，旁边各有一个空白压力表
shots.prompt_en: A water drop icon and an air icon, each next to a blank pressure gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 供给实验室的水和压缩空气，

shots.section_title: 压缩机稳住水压和气压
shots.scene: 压力表指针稳定在中间
shots.prompt_en: A blank pressure gauge with its needle holding steady in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 压力靠它们保持稳定。

shots.section_title: 每个房间有自己的过滤器
shots.scene: 楼层平面图：每个房间连着一个独立的小滤网
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan diagram where each room is connected to its own small filter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 楼下每个房间，
overlay: 每个房间有自己的过滤器

shots.section_title: 每个房间有自己的过滤器
shots.scene: 老李指着一根通往某个房间的风管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at an air duct leading down to one particular room.
shots.narration: 都接着自己独立的高效过滤器。

shots.section_title: 每个房间有自己的过滤器
shots.scene: 一个房间的滤网单独亮起，其他房间不受影响
shots.prompt_en: One room's filter icon lights up on a floor plan while the other rooms stay unchanged. No people.
shots.narration: 每间房的空气，都单独过滤。

shots.scene: 风管上的风阀执行器特写，面板空白
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a motorized damper actuator mounted on an air duct, with a blank face. No people.
shots.narration: 这个装置叫风阀。

shots.scene: 风管剖面里的阀片从关到开转动，气流箭头变大
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a duct where a damper blade turns from closed to open and the airflow arrows grow larger. No people.
shots.narration: 阀门一开一关，调节风量大小。

shots.scene: 多个房间的气流箭头大小不同，保持平衡
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan with airflow arrows of different sizes for each room, balanced. No people.
shots.narration: 各个房间的气流，就这样配平。

shots.scene: 一台更大的不锈钢排风过滤箱，上方两只空白压差表
shots.prompt_en: A large stainless steel exhaust filter housing with two blank pressure gauges mounted above it. No people.
shots.narration: 这台大箱子，是排风过滤单元。

shots.scene: 脏空气带着小点进入箱子，出来变成干净气流
shots.prompt_en: Air full of small dots enters the filter housing and clean air arrows leave it. No people.
shots.narration: 空气离开实验楼之前，

shots.scene: 滤网上积着小颗粒，箭头指向室外
shots.prompt_en: Tiny particles caught on a pleated filter, with an arrow pointing outdoors. No people.
shots.narration: 先把颗粒物滤干净，再放出去。

shots.scene: 老李和阿杰在屋面上，仰望两台锥形排风机
shots.prompt_en: On the roof, the facility engineer and the young male student look up at two tall cone-shaped exhaust fans under a blue sky.
shots.narration: 屋顶上，是高空排放风机。

shots.scene: 风机向上喷出一道高高的气柱
shots.prompt_en: An exhaust fan shoots a tall straight plume of air high into the sky. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤后的排风，被高速射向高空。

shots.scene: 气柱在高空散开
shots.prompt_en: The air plume spreads out high above the building. No people.
shots.narration: 以高速气柱排向高空，

shots.scene: 过滤网图标和风机图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: A filter icon with a green check mark next to a fan icon with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 确保病原体在排放前被有效滤除。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开一本空白讲义，指着里面的示意图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a blank handbook and points at a simple diagram inside.
shots.narration: 这些设备的原理，讲义里还会细讲。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现控制柜、空气处理机组、风阀三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a control cabinet, an air handling unit and a damper.
shots.narration: 设备层统一控制，送风先过滤。

shots.scene: 排风过滤箱和高空风机图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an exhaust filter housing and a tall roof exhaust fan. No people.
shots.narration: 排风过滤，再高空排放。

shots.scene: 压缩机、风阀、房间滤网三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an air compressor, a damper and a small room filter. No people.
shots.narration: 压缩机稳压，风阀调气流。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在屋顶风机旁，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the roof exhaust fans and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 看不见的设备，守护看得见的安全，再见！
